name: any-cowart
description: A native tldraw canvas for Codex, backed by any_cowart_mcp. Use render_any_cowart_canvas_widget to open, reopen, or explicitly refresh the canvas, and reuse an existing widget for any-cowart workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Open a native tldraw canvas and reuse it across any-cowart workflows.
interface.longDescription: any-cowart brings a tldraw-powered native widget canvas into Codex for visual planning and creative iteration. The any_cowart_mcp server provides the canvas and project-backed state tools; render_any_cowart_canvas_widget opens, reopens, or explicitly refreshes the native canvas. Once the widget is open, image generation, annotation editing, HTML, Slides, and other any-cowart workflows should reuse it and let MCP-backed storage synchronization update the canvas without rendering another widget tab.
defaultPrompt: Open the any-cowart canvas for this project.
Use my any-cowart annotation screenshot to generate a clean revised image beside the original.
Generate a new image into the selected any-cowart AI image holder.
